name: Crazy Eights
tagline: Match suit or rank, eights are wild. First to empty their hand wins.

options.label: Q skips, A reverses, 2 draws two

rulesSummary: Five cards each (seven with two players). On your turn, play a card matching the rank or suit of the top of the pile — or draw one card (you may draw even if you could play).
An eight can go on anything: call the suit the next player must follow (or they play another eight). A turned-up eight lets the dealer call the suit.
Special cards (option): a queen skips the next player, an ace reverses direction, a two makes the next player draw two — unless they play another two, passing on the lot.
Down to one card? Say “last card!” before the next player moves, or draw two. When the stock runs out the pile (but its top card) is shuffled into a new one.
First out wins the hand. Everyone else scores the cards they hold: eights 50, pictures 10, others their number (ace 1). When someone reaches the target, the lowest score wins.
